task.description:
Design the API-01 REST conventions module for the BPM Platform.

API-01 requires all platform endpoints to follow REST conventions with RFC 9457 Problem Details error format and Content-Type enforcement.

Produce a design artefact at src/design/api_conventions.md covering:

1. **src/api/errors.zig** — RFC 9457 Problem Details builder
   - ProblemDetails struct: type (URI), title, status, detail fields
   - Helper constructor functions: problemBadRequest, problemNotFound, problemConflict, problemUnprocessable, problemUnsupportedMediaType, problemInternalError, problemServiceUnavailable
   - JSON serialisation of ProblemDetails (all fields, allocator-based)
   - The `type` URI format: `https://bpm.example.com/problems/<slug>`

2. **src/api/middleware/content_type.zig** — Content-Type enforcement middleware
   - Function to check that requests with a body (POST, PUT, PATCH) carry `Content-Type: application/json`
   - Returns HTTP 415 Problem Details response if Content-Type is wrong or absent
   - PUT with no body: returns HTTP 400

3. **src/api/response.zig** — HTTP response helper
   - Standardised response builder: status code + JSON body
   - Success response helpers: ok(body), created(body), noContent()
   - All responses set `Content-Type: application/json`

Constraints:
- No DB schema changes
- No I/O in pure functions
- All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator
- The existing HandlerResult type in each route file (status_code + body) is the output type — ensure the design aligns with it
- Map every AC in API-01 to a specific function or middleware component

Existing code context:
- src/api/routes/definitions.zig, instances.zig, tasks.zig already define HandlerResult{status_code: u16, body: []u8}
- The design must be compatible with these existing handler signatures
- middleware/ directory currently empty
acceptance_criteria: Every API-01 acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element in the artefact
All new types are defined with fields and Zig types
Design clearly shows how existing HandlerResult-based handlers integrate with the new modules

result.summary: Design artefact for api_conventions: RFC 9457 Problem Details builder (errors.zig), Content-Type enforcement middleware (middleware/content_type.zig), and standardised success response helpers (response.zig). All API-01 acceptance criteria mapped to concrete design elements.
